title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-6lxk: 7 clippy warnings in lichen-schc std_ext module dead code
description: The std_ext module in rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs has dead code that fails clippy with -D warnings: unused import `std_ext::*`, struct FragmentReceiver never constructed, struct ReceiverResult never constructed, multiple associated items never used. Additionally: implicit_saturating_sub in abs_window() and map_entry pattern in receive(). These should be cleaned up or the module should be properly integrated.
